US Strikes Iran After Tanker Attacks in Strait of Hormuz

The United States has launched strikes against Iran in response to attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. These actions have led to the revocation of Iran's oil sanctions waiver and heightened tensions between the two nations. The conflict's impact is being felt globally, affecting energy supplies and international trade.
